what: client IP behind the Vercel rewrite, verified proxy mode
rule: Vercel middleware (middleware.js) rewrites /api/* to Render and sets x-nearcarta-proxy from the Vercel env NC_PROXY_SECRET (sensitive). Render trusts x-vercel-forwarded-for only when x-nearcarta-proxy equals PROXY_SECRET (timing-safe, at least 32 chars). Otherwise it ignores x-vercel-forwarded-for and keys on cf-connecting-ip. The secret is in neither the repo nor any response.

two_ip_test.result: A is limited while B visitors on the same Vercel egress IP still get 200: each visitor has its own quota

spoof_direct_test.sent: 22 requests on one connection, each with a different fake x-vercel-forwarded-for (203.0.113.1-22) and a wrong x-nearcarta-proxy
spoof_direct_test.result: fake visitor IPs buy no extra quota: the key stays the real connecting IP
